# Design: Phase Duration Histogram in Metrics Dashboard

## Architecture Decision

**Pure server-side rendering** — the histogram is generated in Python (`dashboard.py`) as HTML+CSS. No JavaScript chart library needed. This follows the existing pattern where `_phase_table()`, `_usage_section()`, and `_milestone_card()` all produce static HTML fragments via f-strings.

**Rationale**: The dashboard is a single static HTML file regenerated by `zsiga dashboard`. Adding a JS chart library (Chart.js, etc.) would break the zero-dependency pattern and add complexity for a simple 4-bar chart.

## Data Flow

```
PhaseRecord.seconds_used  (per change per phase)
        │
        ▼
  collector.compute_stats()
  - group phase records by phase name
  - compute avg_seconds, min_seconds, max_seconds
  - store in phase_stats[phase] dict
        │
        ▼
  dashboard._phase_histogram(phase_stats)
  - render horizontal bars with CSS
  - min/max shown as range indicators
        │
        ▼
  _render() inserts histogram section
  after Phase Performance table
```

## Color Mapping

| Phase      | Color   | Hex       |
|------------|---------|-----------|
| enrich     | Cyan    | `#06b6d4` |
| implement  | Violet  | `#8b5cf6` |
| verify     | Amber   | `#f59e0b` |
| deliver    | Green   | `#22c55e` |

## Histogram Layout (CSS)

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ⏱ Phase Duration                                 │
│                                                    │
│ enrich     ████████████████████ 148.9s             │
│            ······min→···avg····→max·····           │
│ implement  ████████████████████████████ 219.7s     │
│            ······min→·····avg······→max······      │
│ verify     ████████████ 81.9s                      │
│            ···min→··avg··→max···                    │
│ deliver    ██ 11.1s                                │
│            ·min→avg→max·                           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Each row:
- Phase label (left-aligned, fixed width)
- Range indicator: thin background bar from min% to max% (lighter color, ~4px height)
- Average bar: solid color bar at avg% position (~20px height)
- Text label: "Xs avg · Ys–Zs range"

Bar widths are percentage-based relative to `max_seconds` across all phases (so the longest phase fills ~90% width, leaving margin).

## Files to Modify

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `zsiga/metrics/collector.py` | Add `min_seconds` and `max_seconds` to phase_stats computation |
| `zsiga/metrics/dashboard.py` | Add `_phase_histogram()` function; call it in `_render()` and add histogram CSS |

## Files to Add

None — all changes are modifications to existing files.

## Frontend Note

The chart CSS is part of the Python-generated HTML. Since `dashboard.py` produces the entire HTML string, the CSS and HTML for the histogram are co-located in the Python code. This is the existing pattern (see `_pixel_misaka()` with inline SVG, and all CSS in the `_render()` f-string).
